# Oracle samples

The 14 samples of opengql/grammar @ `16ea71b` (`LICENSE-opengql-grammar`, Apache-2.0), the six `q0*` inputs and `zz_invalid.gql` of `docs/evidence/antlr-exp/corpus/`, copied unmodified. `labels.tsv` is the output of `gql-oracle label src/query/testdata/samples`, without the lines of this README, the licence and `labels.tsv`.
